_comment: Validate-mode golden: a Synopsis whose code is empty is an Error --
it renders as an empty fenced code block, a blank box where a
declaration should be. The front end no longer produces one (a record
declaration that defines nothing becomes an itemdecl or no node at
all), so this hand-written IR is the only way to reach the check, which
is the point: the backstop fires on hand-written IR and on any future
`gadget` is the negative control: a synopsis with code stays silent.
